property: For a valid Boolean variable, the SLS adapter returns the underlying SAT solver's best-phase value.
When the valid variable's best phase is unset, the SLS adapter returns the underlying SAT solver's default best phase.
When the underlying SAT solver records a false best phase for a valid variable, the SLS adapter returns false.
Setting the new-best-phase flag through the SLS adapter applies the same update to the underlying SAT solver.
Passing false through the SLS adapter clears an underlying SAT solver new-best-phase flag that was true.

quote: Guard SLS phase test in single-thread builds
property: The SLS best-phase test is compiled and invoked only when SINGLE_THREAD is not defined.
